events.body:
## Context

`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.yml` are GitHub issue forms the forge doesn't use. The enrollment and course workflows only fire on a title starting `[ENROLLMENT]` or `[COURSE]` (`.forkmesh/blt-university--*.yml`), but `_pages/enroll.html` and `_pages/request.html` link a blank `issues/new` and never mention it. QUICKSTART says "Fill out the GitHub issue form", and README/QUICKSTART say `cd blt-university` right after cloning BLT.git.

## What to do

1. Add `issue-templates/*.md` (pattern: `blt-profiles/issue-templates/add-profile.md`) and link them from the enroll and request pages, stating the required prefix.
2. Delete `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE`.
3. Fix QUICKSTART and the `cd BLT/blt-university` paths.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Enroll and request pages show the prefix and a template
- [ ] No `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE`
- [ ] `cd` paths correct

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-university && bundle exec jekyll serve   # open http://127.0.0.1:4001/enroll/
```
